| Parameter | Default | Values | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Blur** `psf` | Gaussian | Gaussian, Motion, Defocus | The point spread function, the picture a single bright point turns into. |
| **Sigma** `sigma` | 2 | 0.3 to 10 px | The standard deviation of the Gaussian blur. The PSF ends at 4 sigma. |
| **Motion length** `length` | 9 | 1 to 51 px | The length of the straight motion, for motion blur. |
| **Motion angle** `angle` | 0 | 0 to 180 deg | The direction of the motion, counterclockwise from the x axis, as for motion blur. |
| **Defocus radius** `radius` | 3 | 0.5 to 15 px | The radius of the defocus disk. |
| **Denoiser** `denoiser` | Stationary wavelet | Wavelet thresholding, Stationary wavelet, Non-local means | The denoiser that takes the place of the prior. Wavelet thresholding and the stationary wavelet use BayesShrink with sym4, 3 levels and soft shrinking. Non-local means is the one of scikit-image, with h = 0.8 sigma, 5 x 5 patches, a search distance of 6 and the fast mode. |
| **Lambda** `lambda` | 10 | 0 to 200 | The weight of the prior. The denoiser works with sigma = sqrt(lambda / rho). |
| **Rho** `rho` | 0.1 | 0.001 to 10 | The ADMM penalty at the start. It sets how strongly the data step and the denoiser step must agree. |
| **Gamma** `gamma` | 1 | 1 to 1.5 | Rho is multiplied by gamma after every step. 1 keeps rho fixed. |
| **Iterations** `iterations` | 20 | 1 to 200 | How many ADMM steps to run. Each step runs the denoiser once. |
| **Border mode** `border` | Reflect | Reflect 101 (default), Reflect, Replicate, Constant (zero), Wrap | How pixels outside the image are filled when the window reaches past the edge. |
| **Channels** `channelScope` | Brightness only | RGB, Brightness only | Which part of the color image the filter changes. |
